name: Rulesets: a new character starts in PvE Mode without War Mode (#4560)
contract: CoA.RulesetLoginDefault=1 (conf/dist/coa.conf.dist) selects PvE for a character without a ruleset; AscensionRulesets.cpp ApplyRuleset removes every ruleset aura and casts PvE Mode 9931032 alone, so a fresh level 1 character must carry PvE Mode 9931032 and not War Mode 1004119. The PvP flag itself has no harness metric and is untested.

steps.label: The new character carries PvE Mode
The new character has no War Mode
PvE Mode survives the next login
War Mode stays off after the next login
